slides.text: some people feel like [[sharing a heavy school textbook]], where you always let me rest my elbow on your side of the desk.

caption:
we didn't have much to say back then, but we always sat together.
thank you for making those long afternoons go a little faster.
send this to the one who sat next to you in homeroom.
